title: SPECIAL PERMIT PROVISIONS
previewText:
On all zoning lots located entirely or partially within a Special Scenic View District, the City Planning Commission, by special permit, may allow penetration by a sign or building or other structure of a view plane and grant minor modifications of open space, lot coverage, yards and height and setback regulations of the underlying district. blocks.plainText: On all zoning lots located entirely or partially within a Special Scenic View District, the City Planning Commission, by special permit, may allow penetration by a sign or building or other structure of a view plane and grant minor modifications of open space, lot coverage, yards and height and setback regulations of the underlying district. As a condition for such modifications, the Commission shall find:

blocks.html: (a)        that any penetration of a view plane shall not significantly obstruct the scenic view which is to be protected by the provisions of this Chapter;
blocks.plainText: (a) that any penetration of a view plane shall not significantly obstruct the scenic view which is to be protected by the provisions of this Chapter;

blocks.html: (b)        that any penetration of a view plane will cause the minimal obstruction consistent with reasonable development and bulk distribution on the zoning lot; and
blocks.plainText: (b) that any penetration of a view plane will cause the minimal obstruction consistent with reasonable development and bulk distribution on the zoning lot; and

blocks.html: (c)        that any bulk modifications on a zoning lot will not affect adversely any other zoning lots outside the development, by restricting access of light and air.
blocks.plainText: (c) that any bulk modifications on a zoning lot will not affect adversely any other zoning lots outside the development, by restricting access of light and air.

blocks.html: In reaching a determination for such modifications, the Commission shall be guided by the description of the scenic view to be made part of this Chapter at the time of the designation of a Special Scenic View District.
blocks.plainText: In reaching a determination for such modifications, the Commission shall be guided by the description of the scenic view to be made part of this Chapter at the time of the designation of a Special Scenic View District.

blocks.html: The Commission may prescribe appropriate conditions and safeguards to protect the scenic view and to minimize the adverse effects on the character of the surrounding areas.
